gap: No result ChatGPT got states that a portable power station used as a sump pump's battery backup can switch its own AC outlets off during an outage: BLUETTI's AC-ECO mode cuts AC output after 1–4 hours of low or no load, and a pump draws almost nothing between cycles. Its manual says ECO is on by default, and ECO does not run while the station is charging from the wall, so it only acts once grid power is gone. ECO must be turned off in the BLUETTI app before you rely on the station.
standout_why: I compared against the two cited Consumer Reports pages: the Sump Pump Backup System Buying Guide and Best Sump Pump Backup Systems. The buying guide covers AGM vs flooded batteries, the shared discharge line, backflow devices and well water. It says nothing about chargers, GFCI, power stations or inverters. The best-of page names 11 tested pumps and only says to use a '12-volt deep-cycle marine battery', with no word on power stations or inverters either. ChatGPT's own answer offers 'Inverter + battery' as an option but gives no setup warning. None of them mentions auto-off or ECO behaviour. I scored this 2, not 3, because the finding decides a setting and a test, not which products go in the cart.
kit_items: Power station: BLUETTI AC180 (1,152 Wh, 1,800 W AC). BLUETTI sells it in the approved store, and its manual gives an AC switchover time under 20 ms. Turn AC-ECO off in the BLUETTI app first.

The existing AC sump pump plugs straight into the AC180. The 2,700 W 'Power Lifting' figure is not motor surge headroom: in BLUETTI's AC200P L manual, that mode is described as for resistive loads only. Test the pump's start on the station before you depend on it.

findings.label: ECO mode auto-off window and threshold
findings.value: AC output turns off after 1, 2, 3 or 4 hours at a load below 10–30 W (AC); both settings can be changed only in the BLUETTI app
findings.source_title: BLUETTI AC180 portable power station review (Lee Shipman, The Gadgeteer, 2023-06-15)
findings.note: Lee Shipman: 'The while here is 1, 2, 3 or 4 hours, and the low load is 10W – 30W for AC loads.' He found no way to change it from the front buttons. A sump pump draws close to 0 W between cycles, so ECO counts it as 'no load'.

findings.label: UPS switchover time
findings.source_title: BLUETTI AC180 portable power station review (Lee Shipman, The Gadgeteer)
findings.note: Lee Shipman quotes the manual: 'switching time is less than 20 milliseconds'. In his test a TV did not notice the switchover.

findings.product: BLUETTI AC200P L (same BLUETTI ECO firmware family)
findings.label: ECO default state and when it acts
findings.value: AC-ECO and DC-ECO are 'enabled by default'; AC-ECO 'is not available when the AC200P L is charging from an AC source'
findings.source_title: Bluetti AC200P L user manual, p.21 (ManualsLib mirror)
findings.note: This is why the trap stays hidden: while the station is on the wall ECO is off, so the pump works in every test. It switches on once the outage starts. The manual also says Power Lifting is 'only suitable for resistive loads', which a pump motor is not. This is a different model from the AC180. I couldn't open the AC180 or Elite 200 V2 manual text to confirm the same default for them.
